WITH d1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999
), d2 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999
), d3 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999
)
SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name,
       max(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       max(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       max(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM (
    SELECT ret.sr_customer_sk, ret.sr_item_sk, ret.sr_ticket_number, ret.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns AS ret
    JOIN d2 ON ret.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
) AS sr
JOIN (
    SELECT cat.cs_bill_customer_sk, cat.cs_item_sk, cat.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales AS cat
    JOIN d3 ON cat.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
) AS cs ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT sales.ss_customer_sk, sales.ss_item_sk, sales.ss_ticket_number, sales.ss_net_profit, sales.ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales AS sales
    JOIN d1 ON sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
) AS ss ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
JOIN store AS s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN item AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
